constituentArticles.title: Doubling of target of Lakhpati Didis to 6 crore
constituentArticles.text: Government crossed 3 crore Lakhpati Didis ahead of March 2027 timeline. New target: 6 crore Lakhpati Didis by March 2029. AIF loan target doubled from ₹1L Cr to ₹2L Cr.
